type.description: Resource kind: track, album, artist, playlist, show or episode when advertised. Defaults to track

album.description: Search by album name, can only be used when searching albums, and tracks

artist.description: Search by artist name, can only be used when searching artists, albums and tracks

year.description: Search by year, can only be used when searching albums, years, and tracks. You can pass a range like 1990-2000

nextToken.description: Copy the opaque continuation from the previous result with the same query and filters.
